tools.description: design.execute {deck,side,operation,args:{...}} → 体力显示用element.update patch设置countFieldId为真实数字字段、countMax上限、countSlots固定总格数、countSlotsFieldId绑定总格数数字字段（优先，0不显示）、countHalf:true支持半格、countEmptyOpacity:0-1控制空格。精细设计。operation: material.apply(ids,material:gold/silver/bronze/parchment/jade/lacquer) 对形状应用材质，替换填充纹理描边阴影； clip.create(ids,source) 用真实矩形/椭圆/路径元素裁切所选图层，源不单独显示；clip.release(ids)解除；暂不支持嵌套。 skill.create(title,body,titleField?,bodyField?,x?,y?,width?,fontSize?) 创建带自适应底板的技能块； style.save(name,properties,style?更新)/style.apply(style,ids)/style.reset(style,ids)/style.detach(ids)；component.save(name,ids,component?更新并同步)/component.insert(component,x?,y?)/component.sync(component)/component.reset(component)/component.detach(ids)；layout.anchor(ids,horizontal:left/right/center/stretch,vertical:top/bottom/center/stretch)/layout.flow(ids,direction:horizontal/vertical,gap?,padding?,x?,y?,width?,align?)/layout.grow(ids,maxHeight,image?,minImageHeight?)/layout.clear(ids)/layout.guide(axis:x/y,value或clear:true)。element.precise(ids,x?,y?,width?,height?,unit:px/mm)支持四则算式精确排版；text.snippet.save(name,text)保存规则片段；text.snippet.insert(ids,snippet)插入静态文本。先查询真实ID。共享更新影响全项目；局部覆盖默认保留。component.reset会丢弃全部实例覆盖，需确认。文字方向用element.update patch设置writingMode:horizontal/vertical-rl/vertical-lr；竖排中英文均为直立字形，borderColor/borderWidth设文字描边。形状纹理用element.update patch设置textureAssetId（先asset.list取得真实图片ID）、textureMode:cover/repeat、textureScale:正数；纹理优先于渐变和纯色。效果用element.update patch设置padding/paragraphSpacing/firstLineIndent/inlineIconScale/inlineIconOffset/gradient:{from,to,angle}/shadow:{color,blur,x,y}/imageMask:ellipse或rectangle/maskPath:0-100坐标SVG路径/blendMode。
